description_en: Queries whether the suggestion feature is enabled for an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 用DescribeAdviceServiceEnabled来查询建议服务是否开启
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-advice-service-enabled --db-cluster-id am-2ze0vp0j6t3to0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAdviceServiceEnabled

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
